description: This dataset contains high-resolution weather observations collected from a balloon flight on August 18, 2018. It records temporal data with second-level precision alongside geospatial coordinates, including longitude, latitude, and altitude. Key atmospheric measurements encompass pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction, and wind speed. The data captures a single event, providing a detailed vertical profile of the lower atmosphere. Researchers can utilize this information to analyze local meteorological conditions, study atmospheric stability, or validate climate models. The combination of precise timing and comprehensive physical property measurements makes it valuable for understanding short-term weather dynamics and vertical air mass characteristics during the specific observation period.
